pages.text: Withered Forest, Ashen Wastes, Soulfire Marsh, Soul Sand Valley, Warped Forest, Nether Wastes. Only a $(l)mausoleum$() shows on the surface: its staircase leads 12 blocks down into the catacombs.
A ring gallery lined with skulls, patrolled by knights, leads to four crypts (spawners + chests). The tomb in the centre holds the $(l)Withered Champion$(); its treasury lies north, behind the seals.
